evals.prompt: Configure Dependabot auto-merge for tsubakimoto/turbo-train with CI checks: build, test
evals.expected_output: Repository auto-merge enabled, squash merge enabled, branch ruleset created with deletion protection, force-push protection, and required CI checks (build, test)

evals.prompt: Set up Dependabot auto-merge for my-org/my-repo without specifying CI checks
evals.expected_output: Repository auto-merge enabled, squash merge enabled, branch ruleset created with deletion protection and force-push protection only (no CI checks)

evals.prompt: I want to enable auto-merge for Dependabot PRs on tsubakimoto/skills with CI checks: lint, test, build
evals.expected_output: Repository auto-merge enabled, squash merge enabled, branch ruleset created with deletion protection, force-push protection, and required CI checks (lint, test, build)
